text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san, you really should get changed 
and go to bed early~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It's just a summer cold, but one 
shouldn't take it lightly... *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "A-Are you okay? Oh gosh, um, um...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there anything I can do to help!? 
We're roommates, so don't hold back, tell 
me anything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm quite alright... I truly 
appreciate the thought, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so~...

Pardon me. My apologies for disturbing 
your rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"How is Ardan-san doing? I bought all 
sorts of things for her."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, for me...? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Cold medicine, cooling gel sheets, masks, 
canned peaches... It's not much, but I 
hope this helps.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything else you need, please 
don't hesitate to say the word!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case... There is a special favor 
I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I-I see... Yaeno-san is definitely far 
more dependable, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Until I recover, could you please let 
Chiyono O-san spend as much time in your 
room as possible?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Summer colds are quite contagious, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's an easy fix...! I'll go talk 
to your roommate right away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno-san is amazing, isn't she? I 
couldn't do a single thing...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nu... What are you saying? I believe 
having you by their side was a great 
source of support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That is likely why Ardan-san grew worried 
about you, since you were the closest to 
her."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...D-Do you really think so...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... A room all to oneself is so 
quiet, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should step outside... and get 
some fresh air for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My throat feels so refreshed and 
cool...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that a phone call?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello, Ardan-san? There's something I 
really wanted to tell you after all...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, please feel free to message me 
anytime! Whether you need help or just 
want to chat...! Sleeping alone can feel 
pretty lonely, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you very much. Well then, 
whenever you're bored, please come keep me 
company.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Truly... thank you. I need to recover 
quickly, if only for your sake.
